title: EvidenceLedger
description: Schema for the evidence ledger. Records each external source, standard, or observation consulted during agent execution, capturing access results, authority status, and content currency to support auditability and traceability.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence entry.

source_url.description: URL or URI of the evidence source.

source_title.description: Human-readable title of the evidence source.

version_or_date.description: Version number or publication date of the source document.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evidence was retrieved or last accessed.

access_result.description: Result of the attempt to access the evidence source.

authority_status.description: Classification of the authority level of this evidence.

content_status.description: Currency and approval state of the evidence content.

owner.description: Team or individual responsible for maintaining this evidence source.

notes.description: Optional notes regarding the evidence, access issues, or caveats.
